claims.evidence: Attention strongly on the upper location: very high selection probability (~0.999) for a blue circle. Recoverability if kept: now 0.70, after one step 0.50, after two steps 0.36.
Right is remembered as a green square but is currently unattended (selection ~0.0004); recoverability 0.57→0.42→0.29. A “right” redirection command would almost certainly pick that right location.
Lower is likely a red cross but has negligible selection (0.00009) and very low recoverability (~0.03 across steps). A “lower” command would select it if issued.
Left contains only a flat (uniform) color/shape distribution (uncertain identity), unused (selection ~0.00004); a “left” command would shift selection there.
Attention strongly on the left location: very high selection (~0.99997) for a mostly-blue, mostly-cross object. Recoverability 0.68→0.48→0.34.
Upper is a red circle, right a green triangle, lower a yellow square, but all are currently unattended (selection ~0.00001 each) with modest-to-low recoverability.
